firm_data.firm_description: Gottlieb, Rackman & Reisman, P.C. is a full-service intellectual property boutique law firm that has been providing legal advice and guidance on all aspects of patent, trademark, copyright, unfair competition law and related areas for 50 years. It represents a wide variety of high-tech products-oriented clients, and many companies in fashion and related industries.
notable_facts: Recognized as a Top Ranked Law Firm receiving a Martindale-Hubbell AV Preeminent Peer Review Rating.

email.subject: AI for Gottlieb, Rackman & Reisman, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi there,

Your firm's 50 years of IP expertise across patent, trademark, and copyright work puts you at the center of how innovation gets protected. That Martindale-Hubbell AV Preeminent rating reflects what we see across the best boutiques: deep specialization, client loyalty, and the pressure to deliver BigLaw-caliber work with leaner teams.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for exactly that scenario. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how-as ex-lawyers ourselves-we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
